study.notes: STUDY: SCALE Obesity and Prediabetes (NCT01272219), liraglutide 3.0 mg once daily vs placebo, 2:1, adults with overweight or obesity and prediabetes, diet and exercise in both arms, 160 weeks; companion full paper le Roux 2017 (Lancet) reached through the institutional route, Tables 1 and 2 copied into work/fulltext/companion/leroux2017_scale3y_tables.txt (the article body and the appendix were not captured); the group's packet holds the 2016 conference abstract of the same results and an unrelated exenatide abstract (medians only, no rows); n_tx and n_ctrl are the full analysis set of Table 2 (1472 and 738; 1505 and 749 randomised, Table 1); Table 2 gives observed mean (SD) change per arm with LOCF and the estimated treatment difference (ETD) with 95% CI; insulin and C-peptide were log transformed and are reported as relative changes and relative treatment differences (PCT rows); TC, TG and hsCRP are percent ETDs from the abstract (appendix of the paper, not captured); baselines from Table 1 (mean (SD); geometric mean (CV) for insulin and lipids); pct_weight_change -4.3 is the placebo corrected ETD in percent (liraglutide -6.1, placebo -1.9, Table 2); cardiometabolic risk factors were secondary endpoints (prespecified TRUE); sponsor Novo Nordisk; rob_overall high as in the RoB-2 row already recorded (LOCF with high attrition over 3 years)

json.design: randomised double blind placebo controlled phase 3 trial, 2:1, 160 weeks, 2254 randomised (full analysis set 1472 and 738)
json.reason: companion full paper (le Roux 2017, Lancet) reached through the institutional route; its Tables 1 and 2 add DBP, HbA1c, fasting glucose, fasting insulin and C-peptide rows and baselines to the abstract read (SBP, heart rate, TC, TG, hsCRP)
other_markers: insulin and C-peptide AUC during OGTT
LDL, HDL, VLDL, non HDL cholesterol and free fatty acids at baseline only (changes in the appendix)

rob.justification: S: the RoB-2 row already recorded for this trial applies (double blind, central randomisation; LOCF with about half of participants completing 3 years)

doubts: Table 2 changes are observed means with LOCF while the ETDs come from the trial's model; the ETD and CI are used
heart rate has no baseline in Table 1, so that row stays unconvertible to the percent scale
TC, TG and hsCRP come from the abstract; the appendix tables were not captured
